frontmatter.title: Setting up AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry Collector in Amazon Elastic Computer Cloud
frontmatter.description: In this tutorial, we will demonstrate how to set up  AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry Collector (ADOT Collector) on Amazon Elastic Computer Cloud(EC2) to collect application metrics. Note: This tutorial will set up ADOT Collector on an Amazon EC2 instance in _us-west-2_ with a provided CloudFormation template. if you want to run the example in the other AWS regions, please replace AMI ID in CloudFormation template we provided.
